instagram:
To haunt a place first meant to visit it often.

Haunt entered English in the early 1200s from Old French hanter, to frequent or visit regularly, and in Middle English to haunte scole meant to attend school. The ghostly sense of a spirit returning to the house where it had lived appears in Shakespeare, in A Midsummer Night's Dream around 1590.

A ghost haunts a house the way a regular haunts a cafe.

A Minnesota town answered Halloween pranks with a parade.

After years of soaped windows, tipped outhouses and cows loose on Main Street, civic leaders in Anoka, Minnesota, proposed a large Halloween celebration in 1920. That first year brought a parade, a bonfire at Bridge Square, and bags of popcorn, candy and peanuts for the children. The town has held it every year since, except 1942 and 1943 during World War II.

A town chose to give its restless kids something to belong to.

instagram:
The pumpkin's family was farmed in Mexico 10,000 years ago.

Botanically, a pumpkin is a fruit, because anything that starts from a single flower is classed as a simple fruit. Seeds and rind of Cucurbita pepo, the species most carving pumpkins belong to, were found in Guila Naquitz cave in Oaxaca, Mexico. Researchers dated that cultivation to between 10,000 and 8,000 years ago, earlier than maize or beans.

The porch pumpkin comes from one of the oldest farmed plants in the Americas.

Wartime Halloween ran on popcorn balls and cider.

Sugar was among the first groceries rationed in the United States during World War II. Halloween hosts leaned on ration friendly recipes that newspapers printed before the holiday, from popcorn balls to donuts, cider and spiced cookies.

People kept the holiday by changing what they baked.

instagram:
Most faces we see in objects read as male.

Seeing faces in outlets, clouds or carved pumpkins is called face pareidolia. In a 2022 study of 3,815 adults, people readily gave these illusory faces an emotion, an age and a gender. 90% of the images had an average rating of male, and only 9% female.

The brain assigns a whole personality to a pattern.
